stage: S2-R1 planner authority and confirmation boundary

acceptanceReview.R1: fixed+verified: processImage recomputes from fresh metadata plus plan.rules, rejects mutable-plan drift and cross-type execution fields, then executes a canonical plan
acceptanceReview.R2: fixed+verified: optimizer receives the authoritative plan byte interval and shared search strategy

checks.qualitySearch: middle interval found; highest valid candidate retained; max eight search steps

immutability: resolveProcessingConfirmation returns a new plan; processImage validates it but executes a freshly constructed canonical plan
